legal_and_licensing_requirements.title: Display of Licensing Information
details: Display the Anjouan Internet Gaming License number prominently on the website footer.
Display the site seal validator prominently on the website footer.
Display site ownership information including legal company name, registration number and legal address.
Display links to policies and contact information in the footer.
Include a link to the Anjouan Gaming regulatory website where applicable.

legal_and_licensing_requirements.title: Terms and Conditions Requirements
details: Terms and Conditions should be written in clear and understandable language.

legal_and_licensing_requirements.title: Jurisdictional Restrictions
details: Maintain a list of prohibited jurisdictions.
Implement geolocation technology to block restricted regions.

player_protection.title: Age Verification
details: Players must be at least 18 years old.
Government issued identification should be collected during registration.

player_protection.title: Privacy Policy
details: Explain how player data is collected.
Explain how player data is stored.
Explain how player data is used.
Comply with GDPR and data protection regulations.

website_security.title: Data Protection
details: Store sensitive information in encrypted databases.
Maintain compliance with international data protection standards.

game_integrity_and_fairness.title: Certified Games
details: Games should be certified by iTech Labs.
Games should be certified by GLI.
Games should be certified by BMM.

game_integrity_and_fairness.title: Random Number Generator
details: RNG systems should be independently audited and certified.

transaction_compliance.title: Payment Processing
details: Work only with AML compliant payment providers.
Credit cards, wallets and crypto may be supported.

transaction_compliance.title: AML Compliance
details: Verify players above USD 10,000 transaction threshold.
